scope: 40/40 retained MVP profiles implemented across five families; full 56-profile catalogue and deferred Goblin/Dragon content preserved
source: Specification v0.9 approved MVP profiles; accepted D01–D22

checks.requirement: Seven complete eight-level families, exact ratings and ordinary attack values
testNames: contains exactly seven families and eight unique named profiles per family
<family> level %i preserves approved ratings and portable core data

checks.requirement: Independent portable blueprint copies and invalid-level rejection
testNames: returns isolated copies and rejects unknown levels without falling back to a generic creature

checks.requirement: Thirty-eight implemented including three deferred profiles; thirty-five in current MVP supported summon profiles use approved production data; unfinished profiles remain gated
testNames: matches the enabled engine creatures without enabling unfinished profiles

checks.requirement: Explicit creature caster pools, caps and spell lists
testNames: preserves the four explicit caster pools, caps and spell lists

checks.requirement: Multiattacks, independent breath types, D01–D08 requirements
testNames: keeps compound attacks in one action and alternative breaths out of bite sequences
records D01–D08 ability choices rather than losing them in generic attacks

checks.requirement: Undead/corpse exceptions and reanimation attack stripping
testNames: retains physical immunity exceptions and corpse exclusions
does not turn magical projectiles or poison production into reanimated body attacks

checks.requirement: Siege attack values, minimum ranges, split damage and immobility
testNames: keeps siege minimum ranges, areas, components and immobility distinct

checks.requirement: Every named special ability has an explicit integration requirement
testNames: has an explicit integration requirement for every special ability

checks.requirement: Aim, Brace, Ambush, Rally and close-range disadvantage use authoritative portable context; schema 11 migrates legacy saves explicitly
testNames: Brace deals two additional Guard damage through the production attack resolver and restore
Aim and longbow close disadvantage read planned and actual movement and target distance
Rally excludes self, enemies and incapacitated sources and never stacks
Ambush sees phase-local activity, survives restore and resets at the phase boundary
pending attack fixtures retain traits and phase history through exact continuation

checks.requirement: Hydra multiattack, regeneration, vulnerabilities and restoration; tiger Bleeding and illusion reversal; explicit content migration
testNames: Hydra resolves three bites as one action, wasting invalid subtargets without replacement
Hydra vulnerability and %s suppress regeneration for only that turn
Hydra can regenerate from incapacitation but never from death; reanimation removes regeneration
sabre-toothed tiger applies persistent Bleeding with correct illusion provenance (%s)

checks.requirement: Vine grappling and escape, Spectre Wither and incorporeality, three creature caster pools/caps and restoration, explicit content-v2 migration
testNames: vine uses two distinct tendrils at reach two against equal-sized targets and cannot take a third hold
Spectre Wither requires damage and retains reversible illusion provenance (%s)
%s level %i pays from its own mana, respects its cap and restores its pending cast

checks.requirement: Bristles retaliation and life drain with provenance, immunity, compound attacks, schema migration and restoration
testNames: Bristles triggers only on a damaging melee hit (%s)
Bristles still retaliates against a lethal damaging hit, and illusion retaliation reverses
Wraith drains only damaging hits on a living real target (%s)
permanent %s fixture resumes exactly through all attack boundaries
Bristles incapacitation stops remaining compound-attack bites without another retaliation loop

checks.requirement: D01 Marked Quarry action cost, selected attack bonus, persistence, visibility, cleanup and versioned continuation
testNames: selection costs the normal action and survives every atomic boundary and the next turn
changing quarry replaces the bonus; losing a target clears it without selecting another
the selected bonus affects production hit rolls, not merely the preview
permanent %s fixture resumes identically at every atomic boundary

checks.requirement: Siege reload cycle, area Guard, arcing and typed area damage, owner views, schema migration and atomic continuation
testNames: fire/reload/fire uses three turns and restores exactly at every attack boundary
area Guard shoots the first qualifying entrant and retains its locked impact through restore
Double Action cannot bypass the fire/reload exclusion
real explosions finish after controller death; dispelled illusion attacks stop (%s)
permanent %s fixture resumes identically through every atomic step
owner views expose independent reload state while opponents receive no private readiness or quarry state

checks.requirement: Siege Catapult double structure damage, unchanged creature damage, illusion restrictions and schema-15 continuation
testNames: Siege Catapult doubles structure damage once per segment without doubling creature damage
illusory siege shots cannot damage structures but still damage intelligent creatures
permanent mid-impact fixture resumes without repeating structure damage

checks.requirement: Ballista two-body penetration, exact geometry, independent rolls, Guard, illusions and versioned continuation
testNames: penetration follows one ray, includes allies and never selects a third body
two victims get independent damage, second base damage rounds up before defence, and restore is exact
a miss on the first creature still permits an independent second hit
ranged Guard uses the same two-body ray and spends only one loaded bolt
permanent second-hit fixture resumes exactly and rejects extra or self victims

checks.requirement: Elven Archer explicit arrow choices, defences, Darkness, Guard, illusions, reanimation and portable continuation
testNames: selected %s arrow uses its own damage type with exact continuation
physical arrows can outperform magic arrows against magic resistance
Darkness attack disadvantage is ignored without granting visibility through the area
reanimation retains physical archery but removes magical arrows
permanent %s arrow fixture retains the chosen shot across restore

checks.requirement: Owner-approved deferral of Goblin and Dragon; five-family books, awards and summon-order gating
testNames: five-family MVP retains 40 profiles and 12 non-summoning families
new spellbooks and repeated awards never include deferred families
%s cannot start a new cast even if retained in an old spellbook

checks.requirement: Treant reach, damage defences, regeneration, illusion interactions, plant immunities and portable continuation
testNames: Treant reaches two hexes from its footprint and restores every atomic step
regeneration revives damage incapacitation, caps health and never restores dead Treants
intelligent Treants take illusion damage that reverses for survivors

checks.requirement: Haunting Shade creature passage, legal endpoints, walls, Guard, Chill and portable transit
testNames: Shade crosses %s bodies with exact per-step restoration
interruption while passing through a body returns to the last legal resting hex
damaging Chill uses Int resistance and reversible illusion provenance (%s)
permanent mid-transit fixture restores overlap and continues to a legal endpoint

checks.requirement: Cougar Pounce uses resolved approach steps, target revalidation, base damage/defences, Guard exclusions, displacement resets, illusions, reanimation and schema-20 continuation
testNames: Cougar approaches three steps then bites for five with exact atomic continuation
a retreat or sideways step breaks the final approach run
terrain cost is not extra approach distance
Pounce rechecks the selected target at its current footprint without substitution
forced movement clears approach history
illusory Pounce damage reverses for survivors
permanent %s fixture resumes identically at every atomic boundary

checks.requirement: Walking Tree Shove uses damaging hits, strict Size eligibility, canonical direction, legal footprints, Guard/forced-movement rules, casting/hazard/hold/Pounce interactions, illusions, explicit migration and atomic continuation
testNames: Walking Tree hits at reach two and pushes a smaller survivor with exact continuation
blocked destinations waste the push without rerouting
Guard can Shove a mover without provoking another Guard
Shove interrupts an immobile cast exactly once without refunding spent mana
Shove clears a Cougar approach and marks actual movement
illusory Shove restores damage without rewinding resolved relocation
permanent %s Shove fixture restores every boundary without a second push

checks.requirement: Lion Roar area Fear, independent Int resistance, Pack tactics, ordinary action budget and atomic victim continuation
testNames: Roar snapshots enemies once in canonical order, excluding self, allies and distant creatures
Roar rolls independent resistance for each canonical victim
Fear prevents a preplanned legal approach after the Lion moves away
Lion Pack tactics grants advantage from an adjacent active ally
Roar saves the completed victim index and never rerolls its first victim

checks.requirement: Ghost Frighten single target, Fear recovery/expiry, incorporeality, damage defences, illusion reversal and portable continuation
testNames: Fear has an end-turn Int recovery check and a two-turn maximum
Ghost retains incorporeality, physical/poison immunity, light vulnerability and no corpse
Ghost moves through an ordinary solid wall but cannot finish on a creature
Ghost movement remains blocked by Energy walls
permanent %s fixture continues exactly after every atomic step

checks.requirement: Basilisk Gaze range, Int resistance, D02 Slowed-to-Restrained escalation and Int Escape, real/illusory Int0 interaction and portable continuation
testNames: Gaze reaches four from the Basilisk footprint and does not intercept creatures
Gaze applies Slowed first, then D02 Int restraint without changing Slowed expiry
D02 Escape uses Int against five and does not remove Slowed
real Gaze can slow Int0 constructs but an illusory Gaze cannot
malformed power continuations are rejected transactionally

checks.requirement: Fey Leopard Blink declared path segment, movement cost/once-per-turn state, Energy and legal endpoints, Guard/casting/control/Fear/weed interactions, illusion and versioned continuation
testNames: Fey Leopard Blink replaces three movement steps and continues normally with exact reloads
Energy stops Blink on its ray and is revalidated at execution
Blink itself does not trigger Guard, while a following ordinary step does
Blink is available again next turn and its used state survives a save
Release clears a cancelled Blink marker together with its path and preserves reloads

checks.requirement: Walking Mushroom Spores Con resistance, living-target and Int0 eligibility, exact next-action-phase Sleep, early wake planning, damage/Wake/illusion interactions and historical expiry preservation
testNames: early Spores sleep lasts through the late phase and prevents intervening movement
late Spores persists into next turn, then permits plans after the next Early phase
Spores uses Con resistance instead of Int
damage wakes Spore sleep, but zero damage does not

checks.requirement: D04 Banshee Wail all-team radius, independent Dex damage/Int Fear, cooldown, area defences, emitted origin/lifecycle, concentration accumulation and portable per-victim continuation
testNames: Wail resolves five area magic damage and separate Fear with a three-turn cooldown
Wail reaches through opaque walls and Darkness without leaking hidden events
a saved Wail damage accumulator checks concentration once before a late cast completion
wizard death collapses Spirit servants, preserves ordinary unbinding, and cannot cancel an emitted real Wail
dispel between Wail victims restores the first survivor and stops remaining damage

checks.requirement: Giant Puma Pounce, grapple and conditional Drag; joint footprint legality, half movement, interruption, Guard, casting and portable pair movement
testNames: Giant Puma Pounce adds two to its approved Bite after three approach steps
Drag translates both footprints atomically in direction %i
planned Early Grapple makes Drag conditional without granting a hold (%i)
Drag triggers Guard for the Puma but never for its forcibly moved victim
Drag interrupts the victim cast without refunding the spent mana

checks.requirement: World Serpent alternative all-team Sweep, area physical defence, Guard, active-wielder interruption and simultaneous held-target Constriction
testNames: Tail Sweep hits every adjacent ally and enemy once with exact continuation
Sweep applies area physical rules to a swarm, while Branches remain discrete attacks
Bristles incapacitation stops the remaining physical Sweep victims
Constriction uses the simultaneous snapshot even if Bleeding incapacitates its source
Constriction respects physical defence and reversible illusion damage

checks.requirement: Walking Forest enemy-only Branches, physical Root Network links and Escape, passive ranged cover, illusion/Int0 semantics, private data and versioned continuation
testNames: Walking Forest Branches hit only adjacent enemies and allow no substitute ally targets
Root Network applies physical-eight linked restraint without damage or a timer
root links expire on separation, obstruction or source incapacitation
ranged cover changes production hit rolls and restores every boundary (%s)
creation-turn passive cover is immediate and illusory cover ignores Int0 attackers

checks.requirement: Amphiptere flight transitions, height targeting, D06 intercepted poison spit, Bite venom, legal landing and height-aware atomic continuation
testNames: Amphiptere lands, walks and takes off with exact continuation at every height boundary
landing enters ground melee Guard reach and take-off enters airborne Guard reach
interrupted airborne transit returns to its last resting height after taking off
D06 Spit intercepts an ally, using its poison defence and no bite venom
winged reanimation retains explicit flight and Bite, stripping spit and venom

checks.requirement: Wisp Spark/flight and private phase-scoped Haunt; explicit invisible presence, D17 contact discovery, event redaction, failure validation and continuation
testNames: Haunt reveals exactly one canonical invisible occupant privately for its current phase
Haunt empty-ground validation gives the same result with hidden occupancy
Haunt expires at the Early/Late boundary and survives reload inside its phase
D17 reveals actual blocked contact only to the mover and clears it at phase end
a failed Dash cannot reveal an invisible blocker beyond the remaining movement budget

checks.requirement: Bobby six-step passive invisible detection, Double Action, Darkness disadvantage exemption, sight/privacy constraints, reanimation stripping and schema-25 continuation
testNames: Bobby detects invisible presence at six footprint steps without revealing illusion truth
Bobby ignores Darkness hit disadvantage without gaining sight through the area
Bobby uses both ordinary action slots and loses that privilege while Subdued
a named target lost from detection before execution is wasted without substitution
Bobby reanimation strips detection, Double Action and Darkness immunity

checks.requirement: D19 Gryphon Beak/Claws single-action identity, airborne Dive approach/landing, forced-displacement reset, Guard/Bristles/illusion/reanimation and schema-26 continuation
testNames: Gryphon resolves Beak and Claws as one action and one planned identity
three airborne approach steps add two only to Beak, followed by legal landing and ground attack
Dive rechecks the selected target and never boosts Claws or Guard
Bristles can stop the Gryphon between Beak and Claws
illusory Dive damage reverses for survivors and cannot harm Int0

checks.requirement: Shepherd Sling, physical rider/object suitability, Mount/Dismount budgets, shared footprints and independent stats, casting/Guard/Drag/hazards and D12 death/fall/placement
testNames: Mount costs the Shepherd its ordinary action and then the Gryphon supplies movement
voluntary Dismount costs an action and can precede ordinary movement
projectiles preserve the explicit %s target at shared interception
forced carrier movement carries the rider and interrupts its paid cast once
D12 kills a rider with an explicit event when every legal landing is blocked
Giant Puma can Drag a held ground mount together with its rider
emergency %s dismount releases a hold that only reached the shared boundary
an emergency dismount retains a hold still within real reach of the smaller rider
%s applies bordering fire, death and thorn wall hazards once per network
lethal mounting wall damage detaches the rider and releases the seat before returning

checks.requirement: Combined all-40-profile legal scenario, production attacks/powers, permanent fixtures, per-atomic Node/Chromium fingerprints, private events/views and frozen schema-25 migration
testNames: the full roster scenario is a reproducible legal production setup for all 40 MVP profiles
permanent %s fixture restores every atomic step with exact continuation
D12 no-space death cleanup itself round-trips before replacing the current atomic state

pending: Release acceptance audit against the authoritative source
Original verbatim specification archive remains a release gate
Fair AI and unattended matches, complete browser interface, acceptance/performance/soak hardening and deployment belong to later stages
